records.text: Priority B support tickets have a standard callback window of 4 hours. Effective 2026-01-01. Current baseline rule except while a bounded temporary override is active. Sets the normal callback window to 4 hours and resumes automatically when any temporary override ends. Baseline service-operations rule.

From 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-31, Priority B support tickets use a temporary callback window of 6 hours; after 2026-07-31 the baseline callback rule resumes. Effective only 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-31. Expired temporary override. Temporarily changes the callback window to 6 hours during July, then ceases without replacing R1. Temporary service-operations override only within its stated window.
